name: Tamoxifen
description: A selective estrogen receptor modulator approved for the treatment and risk reduction of breast cancer. Antagonist at breast tissue, partial agonist at bone and endometrium.

systems.note: Estrogen receptor modulation is the intended pharmacology; in males it raises gonadotropins and testosterone.
Hepatic steatosis and transaminase elevation are documented.
Boxed warning for thromboembolic events in the risk-reduction population.
Boxed warning includes stroke and pulmonary embolism.
Partial agonism at bone alters bone density readings independently of any bone agent.

monitors.why: Documented hepatic steatosis and transaminase elevation.
In males, gonadotropin release raises endogenous testosterone.
The mechanism by which the SERM raises endogenous androgen.
Estradiol rises as the axis is driven; the assay reads total, not receptor occupancy.
